title: Wrong yet Confident: Automated Detection of Silent Failures in Location-Dependent Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.21615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report an experience paper applying round-trip offset---an automated testing oracle for location-dependent software---at deployment scale across 32,019 GPS delivery transactions, corresponding to 24,501 unique coordinates, from a single USDA COVID-19 food assistance deployment in Bayam\'on, Puerto Rico. The oracle tests each geocoder's implicit spatial accuracy claim by measuring the deviation between an input coordinate and the coordinate recovered after reverse-then-forward geocoding, without requiring manual labeling of correctness. We evaluated one community-contributed and two commercial geocoders against this operationally validated corpus. The experience surfaces two distinct failure classes, which we report with their respective denominators because they are not comparable quantities. translated_title: 错误却自信：位置相关软件中静默失败的自动检测
translated_abstract: 我们报告一篇经验论文，将“往返偏移”——一种针对位置相关软件的自动化测试预言机——应用于部署规模，涵盖波多黎各巴亚蒙一次USDA COVID-19食品援助部署中的32,019笔GPS配送交易，对应24,501个唯一坐标。该预言机通过测量输入坐标与经过“先逆后正”地理编码后恢复的坐标之间的偏差，来检验每个地理编码器的隐式空间精度声明，而无需人工标注正确性。我们在这一经过运营验证的语料库上评估了一个社区贡献的和两个商业的地理编码器。该经验揭示了两种不同的失败类别，我们以各自的分母分别报告它们，因为它们不是可比较的量。首先，24,501个唯一坐标中有2,441个（10.0%）对所有三个平台都不可见：一种已被承认且无解决方案的失败……
tldr: 该论文提出一种名为“往返偏移”的自动化测试预言机，无需人工标注即可在部署规模上检测地理编码器的静默失败，并在真实食品援助部署数据中发现10.0%的坐标对所有地理编码平台均不可见。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a round-trip offset testing oracle that automatically detects silent failures in geocoders without manual labeling, and reveals at deployment scale that 10.0% of coordinates are invisible to all three geocoding platforms.
